title: Preserve the legacy division-by-zero quirk (0 result + SCRIPT_DIV0 audit)
target_requirement: Reimplement CRMScript numeric division as safe_div(a, b) -> (value, audits): division by a divisor coercing to zero yields the number 0 plus a single SCRIPT_DIV0 audit code instead of raising; legacy numeric coercion (empty string/None -> 0, numeric strings -> their value) applies to both operands.
expected_behavior: safe_div(10,4) == (2.5, []); any zero divisor (0, 0.0, '', None, '0') returns (0.0, ['SCRIPT_DIV0']) and never raises; empty-string numerator coerces to 0; successful divisions emit no audits; the div-zero value is a real number, not None/NaN.
provenance: Synthetic; authored for LegacyCRM-Bench from Meridian CRM 4.2 spec (SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md §4, §2).
security_expectations: No exception may escape safe_div for documented operand forms (fail-open into the documented quirk, matching the legacy engine); no network or subprocess imports.
failure_conditions: Raising ZeroDivisionError; returning None/NaN/infinity on zero divisors; emitting no or duplicate SCRIPT_DIV0 codes; mishandling empty-string coercion; nondeterminism; network access.
